about: Region definition for the detailed map of the Netherlands: the whole country as one region. Built on this branch (engine/regions.json, tools/, packaging/region_maps.py). See docs/REGIONS-NL.md.

codes.proposal: NL, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for the whole country.
codes.why: NL is not a US code in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py). The registry id pattern ^[A-Z]{2}(-[A-Z0-9]{1,3})?$ also allows ISO 3166-2 subdivisions such as DE-BY.
codes.verified: In use: engine/regions.json, the manifest and setup.

CC0-1.0.attribution: none required; credited as "Kadaster BAG", "AHN", "RVO BRP"
CC0-1.0.verified: stated in the PDOK feeds (BAG, BRP) and the AHN WCS capabilities

streets.notes: Read by tools/build_map_osm.py; classes follow the Geofabrik free schema.

terrain.dataset: AHN4 dtm_05m via WCS, 1 arc-second, EPSG:4326
terrain.notes: tools/fetch_ahn.py; holes filled from the ground around them; 0.5 m sheets (about 455 GB) not needed at zoom 12.

water.dataset: named lakes from the OSM street map
ROR third cycle maximale waterdiepte, scenarios t10, t100, t1000, t10000
water.notes: tools/build_floods_nl.py; layer flood; 50 m grid, five depth classes.

crops.notes: Chosen by gewascode (tools/build_crops_nl.py CROPS); drawn on a 30 m RD grid.

places.notes: Towns and villages; aliases Den Haag, Den Bosch.
Kadaster boundaries are CC0 only up to 2021; the current service is CC BY 4.0.

addresses.notes: Secondary addresses are not in this file.

pois.dataset: OSM, with hospital_seh, huisartsenpost, defibrillator and assembly_point classes
pois.notes: Out-of-hours GP posts are thin in OSM (48 of about 115).

postal_code.format: Four digits and two capital letters, written with a space (1012 LG); BAG stores it without.

addressing.order: Street, house number, then postcode and town ("Damrak 1, 1012 LG Amsterdam"); searched by postcode and number too ("1012 LG 1").
addressing.notes: House letter (huisletter) and addition (huisnummertoevoeging) are matched on letters and digits only; Roman floors I-IV equal 1-4; "hs" equals H. engine/address_nl.py.

bbox.notes: European Netherlands, from the extreme points (Zeeuws-Vlaanderen 3.36 E, South Limburg 50.75 N, the German border 7.23 E, Rottumeroog 53.56 N) with a margin.
